responsibility: Declares a lightweight immutable sorted set of function names for use by analyzer checkers. It exposes membership tests by string or fndecl and debugging assertions that the supplied array is sorted and self-consistent, supporting fast API classification without heavier lookup structures.
same_name_distinction: Defines the compact function_set type and its API as a sorted immutable name set; unlike function-set.cc, it does not implement the binary-search membership logic or selftests.
